_comment: Boss keys grouped the way a host thinks when building a board — 'give me all the slayer bosses' — because src/lib/constants.ts BOSSES has no such grouping and the hiscores don't either. Keys must exist in BOSSES; tests/boss-categories.test.ts fails the build if one drifts. A boss listed nowhere shows under 'Other' rather than being hidden, which is what keeps this file safe to leave incomplete: new bosses land there until someone puts them somewhere better. Order here is the order the filters appear in.
